q: The Curry-Howard-Voevodsky correspondence extends Curry-Howard (propositions as types) by adding:
opts: Homotopy-theoretic meaning: types as spaces, terms as points, identities as paths, higher identities as homotopies
exp: The ∞-groupoid interpretation: Curry-Howard identifies propositions ↔ types and proofs ↔ terms. Voevodsky's insight adds homotopy: types are ∞-groupoids (spaces), identity types are path spaces, and higher identity types are higher homotopies. HoTT is the resulting synthetic homotopy theory.
